Name: SCUD Busty Centaur Haley
Author: sunnycud
Description:
[font=Arial][size=3]Haley is a bad girl. She need a punishment, so I transformed her into a centaur. Her hands are tied, so she can't fight back. 

This is my first mod, if you have any idea or suggestion, please comment. 

Technical info:
- Change horse sprite into a busty centaur Haley
- Because of the way horse sprite are programed the farmer shoes will be on top of her hair. To fix this, I removed some pixels of the farmer shoes on all 4 farmer sprite sheets. I only tested on a male farmer wearing pants but it should work fine for farmer girl wearing pants too.

Requirement: 
-Content patcher

Install:
1. Download the mod
2. Use the steam UI to locate the local game file directory
3. Unzip it and put in a \Stardew Valley\Mods
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]4. Enjoy[/size][/font]
